_doc: UI string table (key -> English text). Uncleared display names live here, never in defs (rules.md §20.2). tools/ip/check_banned_terms.py runs its UI pass on data/strings/.
menu_battlefield_hint: Brennmark against the Tormai on Wether Downs. Command your army, hold off the war-band, then raze their camp.
end_victory_line: The Tormai camp lies in ashes. Brennmark holds Wether Downs.
end_defeat_line: Brennmark's banners are down. The Tormai hold Wether Downs.
end_draw_line: No one is left standing on Wether Downs.
objective_battlefield: Destroy every Tormai unit and building.
objective_wave_out: The war-band is marching on your hall!
notify_warband_marching: A Tormai war-band is marching on our hall! (Space)
notice_mine_low: This Gold Seam is running thin.
notice_mine_depleted: A Gold Seam is worked out.
error_need_food: Short of food: raise more supply.
error_not_flat: The ground there is not level.
error_unexplored: We have not scouted that ground.
error_too_close_to_mine: Too close to the Gold Seam.
error_tier: Not yet: requires a stronger hall.
error_gather_target: Choose a Gold Seam or a tree.
error_repair_target: Choose one of our damaged buildings or machines.
tip_move: Walk to a point. Enemies on the way are ignored.
tip_hold: Stand fast and strike only what comes within reach.
tip_attack_move: Walk to a point and fight whatever is met on the way, or attack one target.
tip_patrol: Walk back and forth, fighting whatever comes near.
tip_gather: Mine gold at a Gold Seam or cut lumber from a tree.
tip_return: Carry the load to the nearest drop-off, then resume the last job.
tip_repair: Mend a damaged building or machine for a share of its price.
tip_rally: Where newly trained units gather. A right-click sets it too.
tip_cancel_queue: Drop the last item in the queue. Its cost comes back in full.
tip_cancel_site: Abandon the site. Three quarters of its cost come back.
tip_dropoff_both: Workers bring gold and lumber here.
tip_worker: Gathers gold and lumber, builds and repairs.
notice_defeated: Every building is lost. The match is over for us.
notice_cripple_started: No hall stands. Raise one within %d s or our buildings will be laid bare to the enemy.
notice_cripple_revealed: Without a hall our buildings stand revealed to the enemy.
menu_skirmish_hint: Start from one hall and five workers on Wether Downs, build a base, raise an army and bring down every enemy building. The computer builds and attacks too.
notice_upkeep_up: %s: mined gold is now taxed more. Fewer mouths, more gold.
objective_cripple: No hall stands. Raise one within %d:%02d or the enemy will see every building we have.
objective_cripple_revealed: No hall stands: the enemy sees every building we have until we raise one.
hero_points: Skill points to spend: %d. Press Learn on the hero's card.
tip_learn: Spend a skill point on one of the hero's abilities.
tip_not_learned: Not learned yet: spend a skill point with Learn.
tip_revive: Brings the hero back at level %d with its skills and items.
error_not_learned: That ability is not learned yet.
error_hero_level: The hero's level is too low.
error_max_rank: That ability is at its highest rank.
